text: The U.S. and Iran agreed to establish a High Level Committee overseeing negotiations and multiple working groups covering nuclear, sanctions, and dispute-resolution matters. A de-confliction ncell involving the U.S., Iran, and Lebanon was established. Technical talks remain active under a framework targeting a final agreement within 60 days. Several provisions remain subject to ongoing negotiation and implementation mechanisms.

meta.note: Several agreement components remain conditional, creating classification tension between alignment and contingency.
